The provided documents detail two distinct but related aspects of the Strata software ecosystem: a highly technical optimization campaign for Intel Arc GPUs and comprehensive user-facing documentation for the Strata inference platform.

**A770 Speed Optimization Specification**
The first document, `A770_SPEED_SPEC.md`, outlines a rigorous engineering effort to achieve at least 20 tokens per second (tok/s) in decode throughput on an Intel Arc A770 GPU running the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder model. The current baseline performance hovers around 12.0–12.6 tok/s, significantly below the target. The specification defines strict completion criteria, requiring reproducible benchmarks, correct output (verified via arithmetic and coding tests), and preservation of specific context capacities and quantization formats (BF16 weights, INT8 KV cache).

The document systematically evaluates various optimization levers, ultimately concluding that traditional kernel tuning is insufficient. Work Package 1 established reliable event-based measurements, revealing that previous profiling methods were flawed. Work Packages 2 and 3 tested BF16 projection paths and register/subgroup tuning; both yielded null or negative results, proving that dense projections are not the bottleneck. Work Package 6 explored ideas from a CUDA-based engine (Infernix), such as hybrid CPU/PCIe expert splitting and adaptive draft lengths.
